protocol.domain: full-frame original GT; metric-specific pinned ignore rules
protocol.macro: unweighted three-class Moderate mean; missing classes retained
protocol.latency_boundary: Sequential raw bin/calibration read + native FOV/voxelization + collation + H2D + module_list + final post_processing; excludes GT recall, annotation projection/text export and AP.
protocol.network_boundary: module_list, including architecture-specific internal box decoding and ROI proposal NMS; final post_processing is separate.
protocol.timing_method: H2D/network: CUDA events with end synchronization; preprocessing/final NMS/total: perf_counter with explicit CUDA synchronization.
protocol.fps_definition: 1000 / mean_ms at batch 1; sequential offline latency, not a pipelined throughput claim
protocol.ap_source: Exported KITTI text predictions (upstream 4-decimal formatting); no conversion from README R11
